name: Don't Wake the Alien Brainrots!
desc:
Shh... Don't wake the alien Brainrots!! 👽

Sneak around and steal brainrots while the aliens sleep! 😴
Escape when you wake the aliens up and they start chasing you! 🏃‍♂️
Survive and collect as many brainrots as possible! ⚡

If you're having fun, remember to hit the thumbs up! 👍
